sloka: आरुजम्श्चैव शैलाग्रान् शिखराणि बभञ्ज च ।दिवि च स्म महावेगाः सम्हताः समहास्वनाः ॥६-२२-११॥।।
transliteration: ārujamścaiva śailāgrān śikharāṇi babhañja ca ।divi ca sma mahāvegāḥ samhatāḥ samahāsvanāḥ ॥6-22-11॥।।

translations.english: Huge clouds collected were moving at extraordinary speed in the sky breaking mountain peaks. Those clouds in the sky sent forth fire of lightning making a loud sound.
